facts.text: A hill and scenic area in south Nantong beside the Yangtze, also called Wolf Hill.
Wikivoyage: a riverside hill with a Buddhist temple popular with sailors, who pray for safe passage; the Cao Gong Zhu Memorial Temple is nearby.
Nantong government itinerary: climb Langshan, called the first of the eight famous mountains of Buddhism in China, for views over the Yangtze.

facts.text: Moat-like river ring around Nantong's old city, a 1,000-year-old scenic area with an evening boat tour.
Wikivoyage lists the scenic area as open all day and free; boat trips run at set times.
Nantong Museum, Wenfeng Tower and several museums sit along its banks.

Reopened after renovation on 18 Dec 2025 as the first public museum built by Chinese.
